eligibility.quote: We just made a clean install of **Ubuntu 12.04.3 LTS** and the default kernel are **3.8.0-31-generic** instead of previous **3.2.0-53-generic-pae** (default netbook ASUS 1025C)
eligibility.reason: Concrete failure after changing the independently released kernel; the battery-reading node consumes the kernel's file interface. The fixes change parsing, scaling and referenced attributes, not just deployment wiring. E1-E4 hold, although not every condition is an interface removal caused by the upgrade.

failed_conditions.quote: So file are moved from _/proc/acpi/battery/BAT0_ to _/sys/class/power_supply/BAT0_
failed_conditions.reason: The reported installed kernel configuration no longer exposes the old procfs interface used by the consumer. This does not establish removal from all upstream Linux builds.

The same selection between charge/current and energy/power property families is present in the v3.2 source read this session. Primary code supports a consumer assuming the wrong supported property family, not a rename/removal of energy_* or power_now in Linux 3.8. The missing energy/power attributes named in the specification are implicated, but the specification's own primary-source caveat must govern classification rather than the reporter's rename terminology.

failed_conditions.reason: The complete diff read this session applies the same micro-unit conversion to energy_now, power_now, energy_full and energy_full_design. Use the patch's divisor 10e5, not the comment's erroneous 10e6.

loudness.quote: - charging symbol doesn't appear in the dashboard
loudness.reason: The report and comments describe wrong/missing displayed battery information without posting an interface diagnostic. No claim is made that the code has no possible warning path.

detection_stage.quote: Current doesn't get possitive when charging, so the charging symbol never appears

resolution.quote: Issue #102: Battery info fixed for new laptops. Also I have changed the default path where to look for the BAT0 files, as the current one was deprecated long time ago
resolution.reason: An accepted implementation exists, but the issue and PR comments do not demonstrate the final patched consumer working with an identified kernel revision; recommended is appropriate.

notes: Read the issue, all issue/PR comments, both fixing diffs and relevant Linux v3.2/v3.8 battery source. The kernel family comparison is upstream evidence about semantics, not verification of the exact Ubuntu kernel build. Missing charging indication is the documented consequence of the status parsing/sign problem, not an additional independently evidenced condition.
